title: 第289章没想到这么抢手
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

见周主任亲自来问，陈卫东倒是有些不好意思了。

之前和公社供销社谈了合作，但到现在却没给对方送一次货过去，确实有些不合适。

但眼下他们的生产量有限，一天只能生产制作出来这么多套衣服。

虽然陈卫东也希望能往公社供销社那边送点货过去，可实在匀不出来。

“周主任，实在不好意思，我们这段时间服装的销售量实在太好了，厂子里的货都满足不了供应。”

周主任听到陈卫东主动道歉，却没有接受，而且哼了一声道：“陈同志，你这不能厚此薄彼啊。

你都往县供销社送了那么多套服装过去，好歹给我们公社供销社也送上些吧？

我又不要求你们送太多，多少送点儿，让我们能卖一卖。”

陈卫东想着以后还得和周主任的合作，可不好得罪了对方。

再者，自己这边一套服装都没给周主任匀，是他先对不住人家。

心里思索了一番后，陈卫东便和周主任道：“行，周主任，我一天给您这边匀个十套服装出来可以吧？

再多就真的匀不出来了。

现在厂子一天也就只能生产个三四十套服装，除了得给县供销社送货，还需要给市里供销社送。

这要是给您这边匀多了，其他人就分不到了。”

周主任知道陈卫东找了县供销社合作，可却没想到，这小子竟然都把合作谈到市里去了。

难怪这小子一直没给他这边送来，原来是有更合适的合作对象，把他们公社供销社放在最后呢。

虽然十套服装不多，周主任知道，这时候也没资格去嫌弃。

毕竟他们公社的供销社规模不大，比不得县里的供销社和市里的供销社，人家优先选择和这两个地方合作很正常。

周主任看着陈卫东，点头同意道：“那行，陈同志，我也不为难你，你这边就先按照你说的，先给我一天送十套服装。”

“好。”

陈卫东随后去了制衣厂，和傅砚山说了一声。

回头送货的安排，傅砚山这个负责人得调整一下。

这次周主任过来，顺道直接带走了十套服装。

他来的时候脸色严肃，走的时候却眉开眼笑。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Seeing Director Zhou come to ask in person, Chen Weidong felt a little embarrassed.

We had discussed cooperation with the commune supply and marketing cooperative before, but so far we have not sent any goods to the other party, which is indeed inappropriate.

But right now their production capacity is limited and they can only produce so many sets of clothes a day.

Although Chen Weidong also hoped to send some goods to the commune supply and marketing cooperative, he really couldn't do it.

"Director Zhou, I'm really sorry. Our sales of clothing during this period are so good that the factory can't even meet the supply."

Director Zhou heard Chen Weidong take the initiative to apologize, but did not accept it, and snorted: "Comrade Chen, you can't treat one favorably.

You have sent so many sets of clothes to the county supply and marketing cooperative, why don't you also send some to our commune supply and marketing cooperative?

I don’t ask you to give too much, just give a little bit so that we can sell some."

Chen Weidong thought that he would have to cooperate with Director Zhou in the future, but he would not offend the other party.

Furthermore, he didn't even give Director Zhou a set of clothes, so he was the first to feel sorry for him.

After thinking about it for a while, Chen Weidong said to Director Zhou, "Okay, Director Zhou, can I give you ten sets of clothes a day?"

No matter how much it is, it really won’t be evened out.

Now the factory can only produce thirty or forty sets of clothing a day. In addition to delivering to the county supply and marketing cooperative, it also needs to deliver to the city supply and marketing cooperative.

If this is given to you evenly, others will not be able to share it."

Director Zhou knew that Chen Weidong had approached the county supply and marketing cooperative to cooperate, but he did not expect that this boy would even talk about cooperation with the city.

No wonder this boy never sent it to him. It turned out that there was a more suitable partner, and their commune supply and marketing cooperative was put last.

Although ten sets of costumes are not many, Director Zhou knows that he has no right to dislike them at this time.

After all, the supply and marketing cooperative in their commune is not large in scale and cannot compare with the supply and marketing cooperative in the county or the city. It is normal for people to give priority to cooperation with these two places.

Director Zhou looked at Chen Weidong, nodded in agreement and said, "Okay, Comrade Chen, I won't embarrass you. Just do as you said and give me ten sets of clothes a day."

"Okay."

Chen Weidong then went to the garment factory and talked to Fu Yanshan.

The person in charge, Fu Yanshan, had to make some adjustments to the return delivery arrangements.

This time Director Zhou came over and took away ten sets of clothes.

His face was serious when he came, but he was smiling when he left.
